brief.zh: 程序是一组电脑可以照着做的指令。给芽芽一个起始电量，看看预先写好的步骤怎样得出结果。
brief.en: A program is a set of instructions a computer can follow. Give Sprout a starting charge and see how the instructions work out the result.

rule.en: Add 3 units to the starting charge

caption.zh: 芽芽收到起始电量 6 格。这是交给程序的输入。
caption.en: Sprout receives a starting charge of 6 units. This is the input to the program.

caption.zh: 电脑照着预先写好的步骤，把 3 加到收到的数字上。
caption.en: The computer follows the instructions written beforehand and adds 3 to the number it received.

caption.zh: 程序显示算出的 9 格。这是这次运行的输出。
caption.en: The program displays the answer, 9 units. This is the output of this run.

title.zh: 先写好步骤，电脑照着做
title.en: Write the steps for the computer to follow

body.zh: 给芽芽补电的程序有三个步骤。先读取起始电量，再加 3 格，最后显示算好的电量。运行之前，程序里就已经写好了这些指令和顺序。
body.en: The charger program has three steps. It reads the starting charge, adds 3 units, then shows the result. These instructions and their order are set before the program runs.

body.zh: 输入是交给程序的信息，例如起始电量 6 格。输出是程序产生的结果，例如屏幕上显示的 9 格。换成 1 格再运行一次，看看同样的步骤会给出什么结果。
body.en: Input is information you give the program, such as a starting charge of 6 units. Output is what the program produces, such as the 9 units on the screen. Try a starting charge of 1 unit and see what the same steps produce.

prompt.zh: 看看刚才这次补电。你把哪个数交给了程序？
prompt.en: Look at the run you just made. Which number did you give the program?

options.zh: 装进读数槽的起始电量
options.en: The starting charge I put in the reader

options.zh: 补电规则里要加的格数
options.en: The number of units in the charging rule

options.zh: 电量屏最后显示的读数
options.en: The final reading on the display

feedback.zh: 读数槽把你选的起始电量交给程序，这是输入。程序照规则补电，电量屏显示的结果就是输出。
feedback.en: The reader sends your chosen starting charge into the program. That is the input. The program applies its rule and the display shows the output.
